verdict.rationale: Chargebee's dunning docs confirm automated retries and email reminders for expiring/failed cards (chargebee-docs-11, chargebee-docs-12), and hosted pages are documented for PCI-compliant card capture/update (chargebee-docs-22), but no evidence explicitly mentions a network account updater service or backup payment method fallback logic. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of network account updater integration, backup/secondary payment method support, and independent confirmation these auto-update cards without manual customer action.
